summary.text: Joseph Arminio, who goes by "Dr. Joe," is the Republican nominee. According to his campaign website, he holds a Ph.D. in political science from MIT and has worked in public policy and as a teacher, author and publisher, and he previously ran in a 2008 Republican congressional primary in Maryland. His campaign centers on an economic-reform proposal he calls the American Prosperity Plan and on a foreign policy of avoiding foreign wars.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Wilmington, Delaware, and attended St. Edmond's Academy and Tower Hill.

Earned a B.A. in political science from Johns Hopkins University and a Ph.D. in political science from MIT, with an emphasis on international relations and national defense policy; he also says he was a Delaware Rotary scholar who audited the War Studies master's program at King's College London.
Describes interning in the Washington office of U.S. Sen. William V. Roth, briefly working for Northrop Grumman, and managing Defense Department accounts for Sprint Government Systems Division.
Says he has done contract work for the Defense Department, the American Enterprise Institute and High Frontier, and chaired the National Coalition for Defense from 1996 to 2000.
Says he published The Citizens' Monitor, a Maryland-based publication, from 2004 to 2007, and has authored seven books on American policy and history.
Says he ran in the 2008 Republican primary for Maryland's 1st Congressional District.

Has taught history, world politics, American government, and speech and debate at American University, Lincoln University and his own business, Statesman Debate Institute, and runs a video channel called America Resurgent.
